FGOCORE-VISUAL_QUALITY.title: Character model quality
FGOCORE-VISUAL_QUALITY.hover.desc: Selects the resolution of character animation resources. High is used only when that character includes HD resources; otherwise it safely falls back to Balanced. Changes apply from the next combat.
FGOCORE-ANIMATION_SMOOTHING.title: Animation smoothing
FGOCORE-ANIMATION_SMOOTHING.hover.desc: Adjusts frame blending and subtle character motion. Enhanced looks softer but adds a small amount of drawing work. Changes apply to newly created character visuals.
